control: Training-inner window F1, balanced accuracy, higher threshold; confirmation=1
selection_scope: Inner participant-held-out scores and raw truth from outer TRAIN people only
event_gate: Consecutive above-threshold windows; reset on low score, record change or non-0.5s stride; no exit hold or backdating
deployment: Separate full-cohort grouped-inner policy selection, then full fit; deployment training replay is not held-out performance
limits: 110% budget is an engineering choice and does not guarantee outer-test budget
Raw threshold is_fog and event_fog remain separate
